name: Dyadrine
description: A mechan abandoned on an uncharted moon who grafted local flora onto itself until plant and machine became indistinguishable.

description_citations.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
description_citations.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Abandoned on a moon, Dyadrine grafts local flora onto itself.
timeline.quote: After years of analysis, the mechan determined that local flora contained sufficient structural integrity from which to graft repairs onto themself.
